size_floor.applies_to: buys and SOL-spending legs; SOL-receiving sells of any size are kept

coverage.note: Presence of rows does not prove every trade in a window was captured (ingest gaps and indexing lag of a few seconds are not tracked per subject). Stored trades exclude small buys: a buy under 0.05 SOL (under $3.50 when paid in USDC/USDT) is not persisted; sells that receive SOL are kept at any size. Counts, volumes and wallet stats derived from this data therefore omit sub-floor buys. Live streams, prices and candles are not subject to this floor.
